title: Black Tweed Set & Gold Chains
prompt: An original young woman with long, glossy, wavy black hair and layered gold chain necklaces stands in a full-length portrait. She wears a black tweed cropped jacket with gold-trimmed edges and jeweled buttons, over a matching black tweed A-line midi skirt with patch pockets. She carries a small black leather bag and wears black slingback heels. Her expression is calm and composed. A pale gray studio backdrop with a dark gray floor and soft even light. Palette of black, charcoal, and gold. Elegant and classic, in the style of a luxury tweed lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The gold-trimmed tweed is the signature texture.
- Add 'full-length, head to toe' to keep the heels in frame.
tryThis: Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the heels.
